name: session-titles
description: Honest two-part session titles: the name a session started with, plus a few plain words for what it is working on now, refreshed on every prompt by a small model.

mode.title: Update mode
mode.description: fresh: wait for the model on every prompt (about 5 s) so the focus matches the prompt you just sent. fast: apply the focus computed after your previous prompt instantly and refresh it in the background.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias or full name for the title calls. A small, fast model is plenty.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: The mark between the origin and the focus. It always gets one space on each side.

max_focus_chars.title: Longest focus
max_focus_chars.description: Characters allowed in the focus part. It is trimmed at a word boundary.

focus_style.title: Focus style
focus_style.description: Optional. One extra instruction for the focus, for example: always name the PR number when one is open.

skip_print_mode.title: Skip claude -p runs
skip_print_mode.description: Leave scripted `claude -p` sessions alone, so scheduled jobs make no title calls.
